title: Al-Amanah and the Small Responsibility
summary: Responsibility builds manhood and amanah (trustworthiness). Entrust your child with a task that is theirs to complete (a plant, an animal, tidying up), and hold them accountable with rifq (gentleness). Amanah in small things bears fruit as amanah in greater ones.
try_this: This week: Hand your child a small, consistent responsibility, and agree to follow up on it together.
reflection_prompts: What responsibility does your child take on?

review_defects.english: and hold them accountable with rifq (gentleness)
review_defects.why: The Arabic uses 'بلطف' (with gentleness/kindness), not 'بالرفق'. The English introduces the transliterated term 'rifq', which is a different Arabic word, and adds it alongside the correct translation. This is an addition not present in the source.
